nodes.name: GND
nodes.semantic_role: System common ground with star-ground intent for analog/digital separation.

nodes.name: power_3v3
nodes.description: AMS1117-3.3 LDO steps VIN_5V down to VCC_3V3 for digital supply. Module is distribution hub for 3.3V to STM32F103 and ADS1115. Input and output require bypass capacitors. GND is system common.

nodes.name: precision_reference
nodes.description: REF5050 provides 5.0V precision voltage reference. Monitored by ADS1115 for calibration via AIN1 input. Powered directly from VIN_5V. Output is precision analog rail requiring bypass capacitors.
5.0V precision voltage reference monitored by ADC

nodes.name: TEMP
nodes.description: Temperature monitoring pin, provides temperature-dependent output voltage ~2.64mV/°C

nodes.name: TRIM_NR
nodes.description: Output adjustment or noise reduction pin (TRIM/NR for REF50xxI/AI, NR for REF50xxEI)

nodes.name: NC
nodes.description: No internal connection, leave floating or connect to GND

nodes.name: analog_frontend
nodes.description: ADS1115 16-bit I2C ADC. Measures external analog signal on AIN0. Monitors precision 5V reference (VREF_5V) on AIN1 for calibration. AIN2/AIN3 unused. I2C address configured by ADDR pin pull-up/pull-down. ALERT/RDY output can be monitored by MCU. Powered by VCC_3V3. I2C bus pull-ups are placed in MCU module. Analog inputs require protection and filtering networks.

nodes.name: ADDR
nodes.description: I2C address select. GND=0x48, VDD=0x49, SDA=0x4A, SCL=0x4B.

nodes.name: ALERT
nodes.description: Comparator output / conversion ready, active-low open-drain.

nodes.name: mcu_controller
nodes.description: STM32F103 ARM Cortex-M3 MCU. Primary controller communicates with ADS1115 via I2C. Configures I2C bus (pull-up resistors placed here). Monitors ADC ALERT signal if required. BOOT0 must be configured for Flash boot (likely pulled low). Requires crystal/capacitor network for clock. NRST requires pull-up. Powered by VCC_3V3.

nodes.name: VBAT
nodes.description: Battery backup power supply for RTC, backup registers and LSE oscillator. Connect to VDD if VBAT not used.

nodes.name: PC13
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate functions: TAMPER-RTC, RTC calibration output. Limited drive capability (2MHz max, sinks/sources up to 3mA).

nodes.name: PC14
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate function: OSC32_IN (32.768kHz LSE crystal input). Limited drive capability.

nodes.name: PC15
nodes.description: GPIO, alternate function: OSC32_OUT (32.768kHz LSE crystal output). Limited drive capability.

nodes.name: OSC_IN
nodes.description: HSE oscillator input (4-16MHz crystal). Can be remapped to PD0 GPIO via AFIO_MAPR register.

nodes.name: OSC_OUT
nodes.description: HSE oscillator output (crystal). Can be remapped to PD1 GPIO via AFIO_MAPR register.

nodes.name: NRST
nodes.description: External reset input, active low with internal pull-up. Filter capacitor to GND recommended.

nodes.name: VSSA
nodes.description: Analog ground reference for ADC, PLL, RC oscillators and comparators.

nodes.name: VDDA
